test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_repeated_selector_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT concat('metric_', toString(number % 50)), map('job', concat('job', toString(cityHash64(number) % 10)), 'pod', concat('pod-', toString(number))), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(1000000 + step * 15, 3), toFloat64((number % 1000) + step)), range(240)) FROM numbers_mt(100000)
